newsitem.title: FRANCE: UK Labour leader Blair is barman for an evening.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour leader Blair is barman for an evening.

text.p: Tony Blair, leader of Britain's opposition Labour Party, began a trip to Paris on Thursday with a sentimental journey to a bar where he worked 20 years ago.
"I need more practise," said Blair, speaking accented French, as he gingerly poured a glass of draft beer behind the bar of the Hotel Suffren-Franctour.
During his two-day trip to Paris, Blair will meet Prime Minister Alain Juppe, President Jacques Chirac and address French business leaders.
He told reporters any Labour government in Britain would promote policies of fuller cooperation in Europe.
